source_of_claim: UniProt name 'peptidase inhibitor R3HDML' / keyword Protease inhibitor
current_state: not currently in GO for Q9H3Y0
basis: Traces to one weak 1996 reverse-zymography band on PI15 (PMID:8882727) in a paper that reports no inhibitor homology (PMID:9473672); no inhibitor module in the sequence; no Ki for any family member.
Family-level phylogenetic inference with no experimental support for R3HDML and no demonstrated bridged pair of macromolecules.
Signal peptide plus secreted PI15-type architecture; consistent across the clade. Could be made more specific only with experimental localisation.
